pt.x: Arcana Invocation passou a causar dano mágico e The World (Reversed) ganhou o debuff de redução de dano que faltava. A classe causa um pouco mais de dano que antes.

en.x: Arcana Invocation now deals magic damage and The World (Reversed) gained its missing damage-reduction debuff. The class deals a bit more damage than before.

pt.t: Kathool Adept, a classe de 18 anos do AQW
pt.x: Farmer e debuffer que acumula Madness no alvo e invoca um pet tentáculo. No rank 10 estende a defesa aos aliados. Disponível em /callofkathool.

en.x: A farmer and debuffer that stacks Madness on the target and summons a tentacle pet. At rank 10 it extends defense to allies. Available in /callofkathool.

pt.t: Reworks do PaladinSlayer e do CardClasher
pt.x: PaladinSlayer ganhou o Detect Living (+500% de crit em 20 stacks). CardClasher agora compra cartas aleatórias para buffs, debuffs ou dano. Quem tinha o CardClasher antigo ganha o pet Pyramid Box.

en.x: PaladinSlayer gained Detect Living (+500% crit at 20 stacks). CardClasher now draws random cards for buffs, debuffs or damage. Owners of the old CardClasher get the Pyramid Box pet.

pt.t: Primeira skin de classe: Darkon's Debris High Lord
pt.x: Donos do Void Highlord (ou da versão IoDA) podem comprar a skin, que troca animações, ícones e armadura sem mudar as skills.

en.t: First class skin: Darkon's Debris High Lord
en.x: Void Highlord (or IoDA) owners can buy the skin, which changes animations, icons and armor without touching the skills.

pt.t: Archivist of Time, classe do calendário 2026
pt.x: Sem auto-ataque e com 9 combinações de Index. Uma variante por AC ou HeroPoints está prevista para o fim de 2026.

en.t: Archivist of Time, the 2026 calendar class
en.x: No auto-attack and 9 Index combinations. An AC or HeroPoints variant is planned for late 2026.

pt.x: Alpha Omega, Chaos Slayer, DeathKnight Lord, Dragon Knight, Hollowborn Vindicator, Naval Commander e Phantom Chronomancer foram reworkadas. O DeathKnight Lord deixou de exigir daily.

en.x: Alpha Omega, Chaos Slayer, DeathKnight Lord, Dragon Knight, Hollowborn Vindicator, Naval Commander and Phantom Chronomancer were reworked. DeathKnight Lord no longer requires a daily.

pt.x: Sazonal na sexta-feira 13 para quem não é member; members acessam sempre.

en.x: Seasonal on Friday the 13th for non-members; members can get it anytime.

pt.x: Bard, Troll Spellsmith, Horc Evader, Thief of Hours, Ranger, Necromancer e Guardian receberam ajustes.

en.x: Bard, Troll Spellsmith, Horc Evader, Thief of Hours, Ranger, Necromancer and Guardian were adjusted.
